problem: All seven persistent retrieval misses have indexed gold documents containing the literal answer, yet none was retrieved in three valid hybrid runs. It remains unknown whether the simplest deterministic raw-question BM25 channel would recover them, whether generated queries place them just beyond the current top-5 BM25 cutoff, or whether lexical representation fails more deeply.
simplest_baseline: Use only the model-generated search queries and return five BM25 anchors per call, as in the frozen v10 retriever.
hypothesis: Direct BM25 over the untouched full question places a gold document in the top five for at least two of the seven cases. If it does, a zero-LLM raw-question anchor is simpler than reopening query generation or adding agents.
changed_mechanisms: offline gold-rank audit for raw question versus recorded generated queries
anti_claim: This gold-aware rank audit is diagnostic and performs no end-to-end run. It does not establish retrieval or answer improvement.

framework_comparisons.current_gap: Before adding decomposition capacity, compare it against the cheapest untouched query that every framework already has: the user's full question.
Configurability is useful after identifying whether query transformation or candidate cutoff is causal; this audit isolates that choice first.
Generated queries can discard rare clue combinations. A raw-question anchor supplies a deterministic complementary channel at zero provider cost if the rank audit supports it.
A query graph is unnecessary when the original compound question itself ranks the target; measure that before increasing graph breadth.

frozen_controls: same seven persistent misses and same gold labels
next_action: Do not add a raw-question channel or merely raise top-5 to a small pool. Diagnose passage-level/index representation on the same corpus: gold ranks are 47, 96, 102, 119, 413, and 736 for six cases, with one absent at depth 1000. Pre-register an offline passage-index gate before any new end-to-end run.
claim_boundary: A raw-question gate pass authorizes only an offline retrieval candidate and later paired test. If it fails, the branch is not tuned on these ranks; move to index representation or cutoff diagnosis.
